text: Built a REST API with Flask and PostgreSQL, containerised with Docker and deployed on AWS.
Trained a CNN in PyTorch for image classification; used Pandas and NumPy for preprocessing and Git for version control.
Developed a React and TypeScript dashboard backed by a Node.js service and MongoDB.
Implemented a RAG chatbot using LangChain, FAISS and a Hugging Face embedding model.
Analysed sales data with SQL and Python, visualised insights in Power BI and Tableau.
Set up CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and managed Kubernetes deployments on Linux servers.
